oidcc-discovery-endpoint-verification.reason: Discovery names the extension member connectors_supported, which the suite does not know.

oidcc-server.reason: The id_token carries the extension claim connector, which the client did not request.

oidcc-response-type-missing.reason: The broker shows an error page; the suite asks a person to review its screenshot.

oidcc-userinfo-post-body.reason: UserInfo reads the access token from the Authorization header only, not from a form body (optional in RFC 6750).

oidcc-scope-profile.reason: The broker returns name and picture only, not every standard profile claim.

oidcc-scope-email.reason: The id_token also carries email; the suite notes that this does not violate the specification.

oidcc-scope-address.reason: Discovery does not offer the address scope.

oidcc-scope-phone.reason: Discovery does not offer the phone scope.

oidcc-scope-all.reason: Discovery does not offer the address and phone scopes.

oidcc-alternate-happy-flow.reason: The id_token also carries email; the suite notes that this does not violate the specification.

oidcc-prompt-login.reason: The second login passes every check; the suite asks a person to review the screenshot of the broker's sign-in page.

oidcc-prompt-none-not-logged-in.reason: The broker keeps no session and answers prompt=none with an error page, not a login_required callback.

oidcc-prompt-none-logged-in.reason: The broker keeps no session and answers prompt=none with an error page, so no silent sign-in.

oidcc-max-age-1.reason: The second login passes every check; the suite asks a person to review the screenshot of the broker's sign-in page.

oidcc-id-token-hint.reason: The broker does not take id_token_hint and answers with an error page, not a callback.

oidcc-ensure-request-with-acr-values-suc.reason: The id_token has no acr claim; the broker advertises no ACR support.

oidcc-codereuse-30seconds.reason: A replayed code is refused, but the access token of the first exchange stays valid until it expires (RFC 6749 SHOULD).

oidcc-ensure-registered-redirect-uri.reason: The broker shows an error page for an unregistered redirect URI; the suite asks a person to review its screenshot.

oidcc-unsigned-request-object-supported-.reason: The broker refuses a Request Object with an error page, not a request_not_supported callback.

oidcc-claims-essential.reason: The claims parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported is false), so name comes only with the profile scope.

oidcc-ensure-request-object-with-redirec.reason: The broker shows an error page; the suite asks a person to review its screenshot.

oidcc-refresh-token.reason: The broker issues no refresh tokens.

oidcc-client-test.reason: The module ends only on a UserInfo request; the connector reads the identity from the id_token and makes none.

oidcc-client-test-nonce-invalid.reason: A wrong nonce must be refused.

oidcc-client-test-scope-userinfo-claims.reason: The module ends only on a UserInfo request, which the connector does not make.

oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-single-jwks.reason: The module ends only on a UserInfo request, which the connector does not make.

oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-multiple-jw.reason: The suite lets a client accept or refuse this id_token.

oidcc-client-test-missing-iat.reason: An id_token with no iat must be refused.

oidcc-client-test-invalid-aud.reason: An id_token for another audience must be refused.

oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-none.reason: The suite lets a client of the code flow accept or refuse an unsigned id_token; it skips when no UserInfo request follows.

oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-rs256.reason: The module ends only on a UserInfo request, which the connector does not make.

oidcc-client-test-missing-sub.reason: An id_token with no sub must be refused.

oidcc-client-test-invalid-sig-rs256.reason: OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 lets a client skip the signature check of an id_token from the token endpoint over TLS.

oidcc-client-test-invalid-iss.reason: An id_token of another issuer must be refused.

oidcc-client-test-userinfo-invalid-sub.reason: The connector makes no UserInfo request, so it never sees the wrong sub.
